bar.note: no single bar: a child or SAT model counts when kit/frontier.dominators finds no board entry in its cell no worse on n, k, d, and max check weight

direction.expected_value: A child or SAT model the gate labels board_advancing with an empty dominated_by would be a new point on its cell's frontier; a single-layer weight-8 d=3 code at k above the 5x5 to 7x7 bilayer records would be the first of its kind in the single cell.
direction.feasibility: planner.plan derives the children of a parent in seconds; the gf2_fast RIS screen at the reachability campaign's depth-proportional budget reads a child in 1 to 60 s; a 2D-local SAT rung at 5x5 to 7x7 with a 3M-conflict cap ends in under 45 min; 18 cores.
direction.hypothesis: Single-step code-calculus children of the CSS entries merged since 2026-11-24, and bounded 2D-local SAT rungs at the single-layer cells the board leaves thin, contain a code the trusted gate labels board-advancing.
